long_biography.plain_text:
Alber van Ekeren worked in industrial gearing before becoming director of Stork Gears & Services in Rotterdam. In 2008 he acquired Schaaf- en Boorwerk Rotterdam, combining its machining capability with former Stork staff and redirecting the business towards independent inspection, engineering and repair of industrial gearboxes.

Under van Ekeren, the company became GBS International and broadened its capabilities into component manufacture, on-site service and laser cladding. He remains its owner-director and has also developed GBS TEC, an in-house technical school combining classroom and workshop training. In 2026 he acquired the operations and workforce of a Dortmund gear manufacturer. The business now trades as GBS Scharpegge.
